description: Derde Helmersstraat 51-63 (1895-96): 6 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a dentilled cornice at 14.9 m over a brick frieze; three axes of two-light windows with a transom; square-headed windows under dark brick relieving arches over a dark decorated tympanum on storeys 1-2 with white painted band pieces on the piers at the transom line; flat heads on storey 3; white sills; a bellied iron balconette on a bracketed slab on the centre axis of storeys 1-2; no dormer on the front

plain.note: 51-63: no dormer on the front (roof behind the cornice)

door-left.note: 57: house door on the left axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 windows with a transom, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; doors pair at the party walls
rhythm.roofline: dentilled cornice at 14.9 m over a brick frieze; no dormer

match.note: Derde Helmersstraat 51-63 (1895-96), 5.5-5.7 m; cornice 14.9 m on the 2023-01-12 strip re-taken at a 2.4 m camera height (PDOK eaves 14.0-14.3 read the gutter)

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023-01-12 (camera height 2.4 m) pands 3-4 (57, 59) at 1.2x with a metre grid: ground windows 0.8-3.2 m, storey-1 windows 4.3-6.6 under segmental heads to 6.9, white band pieces at 6.1-6.3, storey-2 7.9-10.1 (bands 9.6-9.8), storey-3 11.1-12.9 flat, frieze 13.3-14.2, cornice to 14.9-15.0; balconettes 4.6-5.3 and 8.2-8.9 m on the centre axis
strip.jpg 2023-01-12 pands 0-6 (51-63): the same axes, bands, balconettes and cornice

schemaLimits: the dentilled cornice over a brick frieze is the heavy cornice
the bellied balconettes on bracketed slabs are the straight projecting guard
the white lintel pieces over the storey-3 windows are not drawn
the tympana's moulded-brick fan pattern is a flat dark fill
notes: Palette: read on the 2023-01-12 strip; placed pands take their own measured wall.
